name: Chai Point
short_description: Organized tea cafe chain in India

name: Cha Republic
short_description: Pioneering Indian bubble-tea brand with authentic Far Eastern flavors
description: Cha Republic is a pioneering Indian bubble-tea brand that introduced authentic Far Eastern bubble tea to South India, building a strong identity around innovation, global flavors, and its signature purple aesthetic. With a diverse menu of 125+ premium beverages, it operates 15 outlets across Chennai in high-footfall locations.
leader_name: Ms. Vanitha Ramasamy and Ms. Kavitha Devaraju

name: Chai Topup
short_description: India's first low-investment tea franchise with affordable, high-quality chai
description: Chai Topup is a fast-growing Indian tea and beverage chain with 37-40 outlets across Maharashtra, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh, known for affordable, high-quality chai and a diversified menu. Positioned as India's first low-investment tea franchise, it offers entry starting at 1 lakh with strong training, operational support, and quick payback potential.
business_type: Private franchise brand offering single-unit & master franchise opportunities

name: Cafe Durga
short_description: Maharashtra-based cafe chain known for iconic cold coffee and affordable everyday food
description: Cafe Durga is a Maharashtra-based cafe chain founded in 2003 in Pune, widely known for its iconic cold coffee and affordable, everyday food offerings. With 30+ outlets across Pune and other Maharashtra cities, it serves a strong student and working-professional base through a casual, value-driven format and a growing franchise model.

name: Espresso Bar Co.
short_description: Premium bar-themed cafe franchise offering coffee, mocktails, and light food
description: Espresso Bar Co. is a premium bar-themed cafe franchise offering coffee, mocktails, and light food, operated under Pick Me Foods and Beverages Pvt. Ltd. Positioned as a scalable franchise, it requires an estimated ?20-30 lakh investment and provides end-to-end support for compact outlets, with ambitions for pan-India expansion despite limited current presence.
parent_company: Pick Me Foods and Beverages Private Limited

name: Indian Silk House Agencies
short_description: Prominent Indian ethnic wear retail chain specializing in silk sarees and traditional clothing
description: Indian Silk House Agencies is a prominent Indian ethnic wear retail chain specializing in silk sarees, traditional clothing, and fashion accessories. Founded in 1971, when Sri Dilip Kumar Samsukha and Sri Tarun Kumar Samsukha established a new showroom on Rashbehari Avenue in Kolkata, adding "Agencies" to the name (the original Indian Silk House was founded by Sri Sumati Chand Samsukha in North Kolkata). The brand became prominent when Mrs. Pratibha Dudhoria took over the Rashbehari showroom in 1998 and significantly expanded operations. The brand has rapidly expanded to over 60+ stores across 10+ states in India. Headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, Indian Silk House Agencies has become East India's largest saree brand, known for its authentic heritage silk sarees and quality craftsmanship.

name: Flyrobe
short_description: India's first and largest online fashion rental platform offering designer clothing rental for men and women
description: Flyrobe is India's first and largest online fashion rental platform, founded in 2015 by Shreya Mishra, Tushar Saxena, and Pranay Surana. Acquired by AARK World Pvt. Ltd. in 2019, it serves 30+ cities online with 20+ physical stores. Flyrobe focuses on sustainable fashion, offering designer ethnic wear, western wear, wedding attire, and accessories at a fraction of retail prices.
leader_name: Aanchal Saini, Shreya Mishra, Pranay Ashok Surana, Tushar Saxena

name: Cotton Culture
short_description: Prominent Indian women's ethnic wear brand offering franchise opportunities
description: Cotton Culture is a leading Indian women's ethnic wear fashion brand, established in 2010, with 43-45 company-owned stores and 22 franchise outlets. The brand offers kurtis, suits, tops, palazzos, and coordinated sets, blending traditional textiles with contemporary fashion. Franchise opportunities are available pan-India with full support in marketing, training, and operations.

name: Giordano International Limited
short_description: International casual wear brand offering franchise opportunities in India
description: Giordano International Limited is a leading international retailer of men's, women's, and children's apparel founded in Hong Kong in 1981. The brand operates 1,800 stores across 30+ countries and offers franchise opportunities in India through Brandztorm India, with 58 points-of-sale across 23 cities and 13 states. Giordano provides casual wear, accessories, and comprehensive operational support to franchisees.

name: Liker Store
short_description: Women's ethnic and western wear retail franchise in India
description: Liker Store is a women's clothing retail brand specializing in ethnic and western fashion wear, operating under N&P Singh Private Limited. Founded in 2013, the brand offers premium-quality apparel including kurtis, tops, leggings, lehengas, and western dresses. Franchise opportunities are available across India with focus on tier-1 and tier-2 cities.

name: Store Senor
short_description: Premium men's ethnic and wedding wear franchise in India
description: Store Senor is a premium men's ethnic and wedding wear brand specializing in Sherwanis, Indo Westerns, Tuxedos, Band Galas, Kurta Pyjamas, and Nehru Jackets. Established in 2023 under Enzed Global Private Limited, the brand operates stores in Gurugram and Delhi, and launched its franchise model in 2024 targeting premium to luxury customers. Franchise opportunities are available across India with comprehensive support.

name: Peachmode
short_description: Popular women's ethnic wear franchise in India
description: Peachmode is a prominent Indian women's ethnic wear brand specializing in modern Indian fashion blending traditional aesthetics with contemporary trends. Founded in 2014, the brand has 42+ offline stores and a strong digital presence. Franchise opportunities available across India, offering training, operational support, and marketing assistance. Investment ranges from ?10-50 Lakhs depending on model and location.

name: Tim Paris
short_description: Contemporary Indian men's casual wear brand
description: Tim Paris is a contemporary Indian men's casual wear brand specializing in high-quality everyday essentials in the value format segment. Launched in April 2022 by Primafashion Global Private Limited (PGPL), the brand has rapidly expanded to become one of India's fastest-growing men's fashion chains. Founded by Capt. Rahul Rajyaguru (Co-Founder & Director) and Sandeep Chaudhary (Co-Founder & Director), Tim Paris blends essential wear with luxury. The brand operates on a vertically integrated model covering design, manufacturing, and retail, and has aggressive expansion plans across India.
leader_name: Capt. Rahul Rajyaguru, Sandeep Chaudhary, Sukhraj Singh

name: Liverpool
short_description: Award-winning Indian menswear brand
description: Liverpool is an award-winning men's fashion brand launched in 2017 as an initiative of Sunrise Bizcom Pvt. Ltd. The brand has grown to become one of India's most trusted menswear brands with outlets across 40 cities. Liverpool specializes in casual menswear including shirts, denims, trousers, chinos, and accessories, promoting "Value for Money" as its key motto.

name: Banana Club
short_description: Premium D2C menswear brand from India
description: Banana Club is a premium D2C men's fashion brand founded in 2011. It offers high-street western wear inspired by global runway trends. The brand operates both offline stores and online platforms, ensuring a "Made In Bharat" positioning. Banana Club raised ?12.25 crore on the Indian TV show "Pitch To Get Rich" in October 2025 at a valuation of ?245 crore and operates 16+ stores across India.
parent_company: Banana Club Clothing Private Limited (Manufacturing) / Banana Club In Vogue Private Limited (Retail)

name: Sports Station
short_description: Multi-brand sportswear retailer across India
description: Sports Station is a leading multi-brand sportswear retailer under the SSIPL Group, offering products from global giants like Nike, Adidas, and Puma. The brand targets high-footfall locations across India with a franchise model requiring ?50 lakh - 1 crore investment, featuring zero royalty fees and comprehensive operational support. Sports Station has over 50 outlets across India.
parent_company: SSIPL Group (Super Sports India Private Limited)

name: Dazzle SportsWear
short_description: Affordable Make in India sportswear and casual wear
description: Dazzle SportsWear is a "Make in India" apparel brand founded by a former international volleyball player. The brand specializes in affordable, high-quality sportswear and leisurewear. It has a low entry cost of ?20-30 Lakh, offers a high ROI of 45%, and focuses on Tier 2/3 city expansion along with eco-friendly product lines. Currently, the brand has over 20 outlets across India.

name: Adidas
short_description: Global premium sportswear and footwear brand
description: A global sportswear giant offering a premium retail franchise opportunity with a strong presence in metros and Tier-1 cities. The model requires an investment of ?30-50 Lakhs, backed by powerful global marketing and a quick payback period of around 1 year.

name: Maverick Turf
short_description: Specialized B2B sports infrastructure and turf services
description: An expert sports infrastructure franchise specializing in sports turf, stadium seating, and portable pitches. The model requires a low initial investment of ?2-5 Lakhs and offers fast ROI of 50% with a short payback period of just 3 months. Focused on selective expansion in metros and Tier-2 cities.

name: Cricket Academy of Pathans
short_description: Professional cricket coaching academy
description: Cricket Academy of Pathans (CAP) is a franchise-based cricket training academy founded by Irfan Pathan and Yusuf Pathan. It offers professional cricket coaching, player development programs, and technology-based performance analysis through PitchVision. The academy follows a private entrepreneur franchise model, rapidly expanding across India and international markets.

name: O2 Gym Fitness
short_description: Premium fitness and wellness franchise
description: O2 Gym Fitness is a premium fitness and wellness franchise in India providing gym, wellness, cardio, and strength training services. It operates on a franchise model with a 0% royalty system to maximize franchisee profitability and has expansion opportunities across Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities.

name: Burn Gym and Spa
short_description: Premium fitness and wellness franchise
description: Burn Gym and Spa offers premium gym, spa, personal training, and boot camp services. Operating on a private entrepreneur franchise model, it focuses on Tier-1 cities in North India, providing full operational and marketing support to franchisees.

name: Nitsa Holidays
short_description: Customized international travel and holiday planning
description: Nitsa Holidays specializes in customized international tour packages and personalized vacations for Indian travellers. It operates on a franchise model in online travel services, offering full operational and marketing support to franchisees.
business_type: Franchise model in online travel services, service-based travel agency

name: EaseMyTrip
short_description: India's leading online travel company offering flight bookings, hotels, holidays, and travel services through franchises
description: EaseMyTrip operates a franchise retail travel outlet model, providing comprehensive online and offline travel booking services, including flights, hotels, holidays, trains, cabs, cruises, and visas. The company supports franchisees with training, marketing, store setup, and ongoing operational assistance.

name: MakeMyTrip India Pvt Ltd.
short_description: India's leading online travel company offering flights, hotels, holiday packages, trains, car rentals via franchises
description: MakeMyTrip operates a franchise retail travel outlet model providing comprehensive online and offline travel booking services including flights, hotels, holiday packages, trains, car rentals, and insurance. Franchisees receive training, marketing, operational, and technical support.

name: Cloud9Trip
short_description: Travel brand under Sohan Tours and Travels; started as air ticketing in 2009, expanded to international holidays and tour packages.
description: Cloud9Trip (trademark/brand of Sohan Tours and Travels). Offers comprehensive travel services including flights, hotels, holiday packages, visa, and insurance. Franchisees get training, marketing, operational, and technical support.

name: Thomas Cook India Pvt. Ltd.
short_description: Leading travel and financial services company offering holiday packages, forex, and insurance solutions.
description: Thomas Cook India provides travel services including international and domestic holidays, flight bookings, hotels, forex, insurance, and corporate travel. Franchisees get operational support, marketing guidance, and technical assistance.

name: Club Travalet
short_description: Timeshare vacation franchise offering affordable holiday ownership programs for middle and lower-middle-class families.
description: Club Travalet, launched by TVTRIPNSTAY HOLIDAYS PVT LTD, allows customers to pay in advance and enjoy vacations in installments without seasonal price fluctuations. Franchisees get operational guidance, marketing support, training, and inclusion of current IT systems.

name: Amber Destinations
short_description: Online travel franchise offering holiday bookings, tours, and related travel solutions targeting middle-class customers.
description: Amber Destinations provides online travel services including holiday packages, timeshare vacation ownership, and travel bookings via multi-unit franchise model supporting 20-50 franchises. Franchisees receive training, marketing support, IT system access, and operational guidance.

name: Southern Travels Pvt Ltd
short_description: Reputed travel company offering holiday/travel packages, corporate/leisure/international tours with franchise model, offices, fleet, hotels.
description: Southern Travels Pvt Ltd provides end-to-end travel services including corporate and leisure tours, coach/vehicle rentals, hotel bookings, and international/domestic tours. The company operates through a franchise model with multiple owned offices and fleet operations, offering training, operational support, IT systems, and marketing assistance.

name: Nexottel Hotel Resort
short_description: Mid-priced full-service business hotels and resorts across Pan Asia
description: Nexottel Hotel Resort is a premier hospitality brand offering mid-priced full-service business hotels and resorts across India and the GCC region. The brand focuses on operational excellence, consistent guest experience, strong sales and marketing support, hotel management, and technology-driven operations. Nexottel aims to scale to 100 hotels and 3,000 rooms across Pan Asia.

name: Trip Factory Pvt Ltd
short_description: AI-powered travel franchise offering customized holiday packages worldwide
description: Trip Factory is India's largest holiday store leveraging AI and machine learning to deliver customized global travel experiences. Operating across 49 countries, the platform handles over 100,000 daily transactions and is supported by a large global workforce. The franchise model enables entrepreneurs to run travel businesses with minimal investment using Trip Factory's proprietary technology, leads, and centralized support.

name: Sonix Car Decors
short_description: Premium automotive accessories and car decor franchise
description: Sonix Car Decors is a premium automotive accessories and car decor brand originating from Andhra Pradesh. Operating since 2010, the brand has evolved into a high-margin car studio-cum-distributorship model offering premium accessories, car electronics, detailing services, and tech upgrades. The franchise requires an investment of ?40-50 lakhs for a 750-1000 sq. ft. studio and provides full training, ERP-backed operations, and marketing support for pan-India expansion.
business_type: Private business / franchise-led car accessories chain

name: Swank Autocare Solutions Private Limited
short_description: Premium automated touchless car wash and detailing franchise
description: Swank Autocare Solutions Private Limited is a Bengaluru-based premium auto-care brand offering automated touchless car wash, interior and exterior detailing, polishing, ceramic and graphene coatings, PPF services, and subscription-based car care solutions. The franchise model targets investors ready to deploy ?75-100 lakhs for large-format outlets focused on sustainable, technology-driven and high-quality vehicle cleaning and protection.

name: Relux Electric Private Limited
short_description: EV charging station franchise and clean energy infrastructure network
description: Relux Electric is an Indian EV infrastructure company operating a growing network of public and highway EV charging stations. The brand offers a low-investment franchise model enabling partners to set up AC and DC fast-charging locations across highways and urban centres. With end-to-end support for site selection, installation, software integration and operations, Relux positions itself as a leading EV charging network in South India and is expanding pan-India with support from energy partners and government programs.
business_type: Franchise & Owned Network - EV Charging Infrastructure

name: BLive EZY Fleet Services Private Limited
short_description: Managed EV two-wheeler fleet franchise for last-mile delivery
description: BLive EZY (EZY Fleet), operated by Blive Ezy Fleet Services Private Limited, is a tech-driven EV rental franchise platform offering managed electric two-wheeler fleets for last-mile delivery. Through a FOCO-style model, partners invest in EV fleets while BLive handles operations, rider onboarding, maintenance, demand generation and fleet technology. With 70+ partnerships across 15 cities, the brand delivers sustainable transportation solutions with low franchisee involvement.
business_type: Franchise / Managed EV Fleet Investment Model

name: My Car Wash
short_description: Mechanized car wash and detailing franchise from India
description: My Car Wash is an Indian mechanized car wash and auto detailing brand promoted by Hetvi Enterprise. The business began operations in 2004 and later expanded into a franchise model offering standardized, space-efficient car wash outlets. The brand focuses on high-pressure exterior washing, interior cleaning and basic detailing services, positioned as a low-to-mid investment automotive service franchise across Tier-2 and Tier-3 Indian cities.

name: Simba Toys India Private Limited
short_description: Premium toy retail franchise offering international toys & games for children aged 3-12.
description: Simba Toys India Private Limited is part of the globally renowned Simba Dickie Group. Incorporated in 2007, it operates 30+ retail outlets across India and offers internationally licensed toys, educational games, puzzles, and board games.

name: Wavex Auto Care
short_description: Franchise and distributor network for premium automotive detailing products in India
description: Wavex Auto Care is an Indian automotive care and detailing products brand that manufactures and distributes professional-grade car and bike care chemicals, coatings, and accessories. The brand offers a franchise/distributor model to operate Wavex-branded retail and B2B supply outlets for detailers and workshops.

name: ONN Bikes
short_description: Tech-enabled two-wheeler rental and franchise platform in India
description: ONN Bikes is an Indian tech-enabled two-wheeler rental platform providing petrol and electric bikes on short- and long-term rentals across multiple cities. It operates a franchise model where local partners run ONN-branded rental outlets using the company's technology platform, branding, and fleet management support.
leader_name: Namit Jain, Shanky Munoth, Shobhit Saxena, Akashdeep Singal

name: AMO Electric Bikes
short_description: Indian electric two-wheeler manufacturer and dealership network
description: AMO Electric Bikes (AMO Mobility Solutions Pvt. Ltd.) is an Indian electric two-wheeler manufacturer and dealership network that designs and sells low-speed and high-speed electric scooters and bikes, operating 180+ dealerships across 16 states and 2 union territories, and offering a dealership/franchise model focused on affordable EV mobility and strong after-sales service.

name: Doctor Garage
short_description: Indian multi-brand two-wheeler service and repair chain
description: Doctor Garage is an Indian multi-brand two-wheeler service and repair chain that offers standardized maintenance, repair and annual maintenance contract (AMC) services through a fast-growing franchise network, positioning itself as an organized alternative to local garages with 120+ outlets across multiple states.
parent_company: Doctor Garage brand group (Kayra Automobiles-linked entity)

name: Yousta
short_description: Youth-centric fast-fashion brand by Reliance Retail for Gen Z
description: Yousta is a youth-centric fast-fashion brand launched by Reliance Retail, designed specifically for Gen Z and young millennials. The brand focuses on affordable, trend-driven apparel and accessories, with frequent new collections that keep stores fresh and high-traffic. Backed by Reliance Retail infrastructure with 50+ stores across India.
business_type: Division of Public Company - Youth Fashion (Gen Z)

name: Red Tape
short_description: International-style footwear and fashion retail brand
description: Red Tape is a well-known Indian fashion & lifestyle brand that primarily focuses on footwear, along with apparel and accessories. With a legacy spanning over two decades, Red Tape has built a strong reputation for offering international style, good quality, and comfort at competitive prices. The brand operates 400+ stores with a mix of company-owned and franchise outlets across India.

name: The Carriall
short_description: Smart and innovative travel gear for modern commuters and travelers
description: The Carriall is known for its smart and innovative travel gear designed for modern commuters and frequent travelers. Their products blend style with functionality, offering durable bags equipped with thoughtful features. The brand focuses on premium materials and minimalistic aesthetics with smart luggage solutions including Bluetooth trackers and tech-enabled accessories.

name: Canary London
short_description: Men's fashion brand offering refined formal and casual wear
description: Canary London specializes in men's fashion, offering a refined selection of formal and casual wear. The brand focuses on sharp tailoring and comfortable fabrics suitable for modern professionals. Their collections often balance classic designs with current trends. It is well-known for dependable quality at accessible pricing with 100+ franchise outlets across India.

name: Specsmakers
short_description: Leading eyewear brand providing prescription glasses, sunglasses and contact lenses
description: Specsmakers is a leading eyewear brand providing prescription glasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses. They focus on lightweight frames, optical precision, and customer affordability. The brand offers eye testing facilities along with a wide variety of frame styles. Specsmakers is known for its customer-friendly policies and accessible store network with 250+ stores across India operating on FOCO (Franchisee Owned, Company Operated) model.

name: Sia Art Jewellery
short_description: Elegant fashion jewellery inspired by Indian artistry
description: Sia Art Jewellery offers elegant and intricately crafted fashion jewellery inspired by Indian artistry. The brand is known for its premium finishing, unique designs, and festive appeal. Their pieces cater to weddings, celebrations, and everyday wear. Sia focuses on creativity, tradition, and affordability within the fashion jewellery space with 150+ retail properties across India.

name: Classic Polo
short_description: Premium men's casual wear brand with signature polo T-shirts
description: Classic Polo is a recognized lifestyle apparel brand offering casual wear for men. Known for its signature polo T-shirts, the brand emphasizes comfort, durability, and clean styling. It provides a wide range of clothing suitable for work, outings, and daily use. Classic Polo appeals to customers seeking simple yet classy fashion choices with 100+ Exclusive Brand Outlets across India.
business_type: Private Limited Company - Premium Men's Casual Wear

name: Silverleaf
short_description: Premium clothing and accessories with modern, elegant touch
description: Silverleaf offers a variety of premium clothing and accessories with a modern, elegant touch. The brand focuses on delivering quality materials and contemporary designs. Its collection typically includes refined daily wear and stylish occasion outfits. Silverleaf stands out for its balance of sophistication and affordability with 50+ outlets across India.

name: Chhabra 555
short_description: Premium ethnic wear brand specializing in sarees, lehengas and traditional Indian attire
description: Chhabra 555 is a well-established ethnic wear brand specializing in sarees, lehengas, and traditional Indian attire. They are known for vibrant designs, rich fabrics, and intricate craftsmanship. The brand caters to festive, bridal, and everyday ethnic fashion needs. It has a strong legacy of over 70 years in offering culturally inspired clothing with premium finishing and 50+ exclusive stores across India.
parent_company: Chhabra Triple Five Fashions Pvt. Ltd.
business_type: Private Limited Company - Indian Ethnic Wear

name: Liverpool
short_description: Men's apparel offering casualwear to office essentials
description: Liverpool offers a wide range of men's apparel, from casualwear to office essentials. The brand focuses on comfort-driven designs with a modern, youthful appeal. Its clothing is crafted for everyday practicality and effortless style. Liverpool is popular for its reliable quality at mid-range pricing with 200+ outlets across India.

name: ISSD (International Institute of Skill Development)
short_description: Education and training organization focused on employment-ready skills
description: ISSD (Institute for Skill Development) is an education and training organization focused on developing employment-ready skills for students, graduates, and working professionals. The institute positions itself as a bridge between academic learning and practical industry requirements, offering structured programs that enhance technical, vocational, and professional capabilities in areas like Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, Supply Chain and Logistics Management, and Warehouse Management with placement assistance.

name: Kumon India
short_description: Japanese after-school learning system for math and English enrichment
description: Kumon India is the Indian division of the global Kumon Institute of Education, a Japanese after-school learning system founded in 1958. The organization focuses on strengthening foundational skills in mathematics and English for children across age groups, from early learners to high-school students. With 200+ centers across India and over 60 years of global presence, Kumon uses standardized worksheets and self-learning methodology.
business_type: Coaching and Franchise - Math and Reading Enrichment

name: MSM Unify
short_description: Global education marketplace for overseas study and student recruitment
description: MSM Unify is a global education marketplace developed by M Square Media to connect students, recruitment partners, and international educational institutions on a unified digital platform. It operates as an end-to-end ecosystem for overseas education, offering tools and services that simplify the process of discovering programs, applying to universities, and managing admissions workflows with 1500+ campuses, 50000+ academic programs across 21 countries.
parent_company: MSM Global Education and M Square Media group
business_type: Franchise - Student recruitment centres and platform

name: Institute of Quantum Marketing
short_description: Modern marketing and digital strategy education with practical skill development
description: The Institute of Quantum Marketing is an education and training organization focused on modern marketing, digital strategy, and practical skill development for students and professionals. The institute positions itself as a bridge between traditional marketing concepts and emerging digital-era methodologies, offering programs designed to help learners understand consumer psychology, brand positioning, strategic communication, and performance-driven marketing with startup incubation support.
business_type: Franchise and Online-Offline Digital Marketing Training

name: IBT Institute
short_description: Competitive exam coaching for Bank, SSC, Railways and Insurance exams
description: IBT Institute was founded in 2009 in Jalandhar, Punjab, initially for aspirants targeting one bank exam. Over time it has grown into a pan-India coaching brand with 100+ branches across the country. Its core aim is to provide quality coaching and preparation support for competitive government and bank-related exams including Bank PO, SSC, Railways, Insurance, MBA entrance exams, and Spoken English with comprehensive online mock-test platform.

name: SpellBee International
short_description: English language proficiency enhancement through spelling competitions
description: SpellBee International is an education-based organization focused on enhancing English language proficiency among school students through structured competitions and learning programs. The company specializes in spelling, vocabulary building, comprehension, and language enrichment, positioning itself as a platform that develops linguistic confidence and cognitive skills in children. With 6000+ school partnerships and 1.2 million students certified.
business_type: Franchise and Associate License-based English learning

name: Skill-Lync and Crio.Do
short_description: Engineering upskilling and software development training with project-based learning
description: Skill-Lync and Crio.Do are modern edtech platforms focused on bridging the skill gap between academic learning and industry expectations, particularly in engineering and technology fields. While Skill-Lync specializes in advanced upskilling for core engineering domains such as mechanical, electrical, civil, automotive, and computer science, Crio.Do concentrates on software development and prepares learners through project-centric training.
business_type: Franchise and Online Hybrid upskilling center

name: Apponix Academy
short_description: IT, software and vocational training with classroom and online delivery
description: Apponix Academy is a professional training institute focused on IT, software, and digital technology skill development for students and working professionals. The academy delivers industry-aligned, job-oriented courses in areas such as cloud computing, DevOps, cybersecurity, full-stack development, data science, digital marketing, and software testing through classroom, online, and hybrid training models.
business_type: Franchise and Classroom plus Online Training Center

name: Brain Checker
short_description: Psychometric assessments and career counselling franchise
description: Brain Checker is an education and career-guidance organization specializing in psychometric assessments, career counselling, aptitude testing, and student development programs. The company helps students understand their personality traits, learning styles, intelligence types, and career suitability using scientifically designed assessment tools and counselling frameworks.
business_type: Franchise and Branch-Based Counselling & Assessment Services

name: Frozen Bottle
short_description: Premium gelato and frozen dessert cafe franchise
description: Frozen Bottle is a premium frozen dessert and gelato cafe brand offering handcrafted ice creams, thick shakes, waffle jars, sundaes, and innovative jar-based desserts with a modern cafe experience.

name: Pabrai's Fresh & Naturelle Ice Creams
short_description: Premium natural ice cream and artisan dessert franchise
description: Pabrai's Fresh & Naturelle Ice Creams is a premium gourmet ice cream brand offering 100% natural, preservative-free ice creams made with real fruits and high-quality ingredients, delivering a wholesome and artisan dessert experience.
leader_name: Kunal Pabrai, Nishant Pabrai, Anuvrat Pabrai

name: Creme Fudge Ice Cream
short_description: Premium marble stone ice cream and dessert parlour franchise
description: Creme Fudge Ice Cream is a super-premium dessert brand offering hand-folded marble stone ice creams, waffles, shakes, and sundaes. Operated under Global Franchise Architects India Pvt. Ltd., the brand focuses on indulgent flavours, premium retail experience, and made-to-order freshness for modern dessert consumers.
parent_company: Global Franchise Architects India Pvt. Ltd.

name: The Fruit Creamery
short_description: Premium fruit-based ice creams and handmade kulfis
description: The Fruit Creamery Ice Cream is known for its fresh, fruit-based ice creams made with natural flavors, offering a refreshing and wholesome dessert experience loved by health-conscious and flavour-seeking customers.

name: Dairy Don
short_description: Premium ice creams and gelato parlours
description: Dairy Don Ice Cream is a popular dessert brand known for its rich, creamy ice creams, innovative flavors, and value-friendly treats that appeal to families and young customers alike.

name: Michael's Ice Cream Burger
short_description: Innovative ice cream burger desserts
description: Michael's Ice Cream Burger is a creative dessert brand known for its signature ice-cream burgers-freshly baked buns filled with rich, premium ice cream for a unique, indulgent treat that blends fun, innovation, and great taste.
business_type: Private Limited / Proprietorship (Sequeira Hospitality and Services)

name: Kwality Walls Swirls
short_description: Modern dessert brand offering soft serve swirls and frozen treats
description: Swirl Ice Cream is a modern dessert brand offering smooth, creamy ice creams and fun, innovative flavors designed for young, trend-focused consumers. Known for its fresh taste and vibrant presentation, Swirl delivers a playful and refreshing ice-cream experience.

name: Cocoberry
short_description: Premium dessert brand offering frozen yogurt, smoothies, and contemporary desserts
description: Cocoberry Ice Cream is an emerging premium dessert brand known for its creamy textures, modern flavors, and high-quality ingredients. Focused on fresh taste and innovative varieties, Cocoberry offers a youthful, contemporary ice-cream experience that appeals to urban consumers and dessert lovers.

name: Amul Ice Cream
short_description: One of India's largest and most trusted ice-cream brands offering 100% real milk products
description: Amul Ice Cream, a division of GCMMF, is one of India's largest and most trusted ice-cream brands, offering 100% real milk products through 2000+ outlets nationwide with a low-investment, zero-royalty franchise model.

name: Giani's Ice Cream
short_description: Heritage Indian ice-cream brand known for traditional flavors like Rabri Falooda, Kulfi, and Kesar Pista
description: Giani's Ice Cream is a heritage Indian ice-cream brand founded in 1956 in Delhi, known for its rich traditional flavors. From a small shop in Chandni Chowk, it has grown into a popular multi-city franchise offering ice creams, sundaes, shakes, and desserts. Recognized for quality, authentic taste, and strong customer loyalty.
leader_name: Giani Gurcharan Singh, Gurbachan Singh, Taranjeet Singh

name: Kiosk Kaffee
short_description: High-quality, affordable coffee through a compact kiosk model
description: Kiosk Kaffee is an Indian coffee cafe brand founded in 2020 in Pune, Maharashtra. The brand focuses on providing high-quality yet affordable coffee through a compact kiosk model.
leader_name: Sangram Patil, Nilesh Pasalkar, Savan Oswal

name: Midway Cafe India
short_description: Pan-India multi-cuisine casual dining cafe franchise offering Indian, Chinese, Italian, Continental, Mexican, and American cuisines.
description: Midway Cafe India is an American-origin multi-cuisine restaurant brand expanding across India through a franchise-led model. Offers casual dining and cafe services with a focus on high-quality, responsibly sourced food.

name: Kulhad Rani
short_description: Traditional tea-and-coffee cafe franchise focusing on kulhad (earthen-cup) beverages and eco-friendly clay products.
description: Kulhad Rani is an Indian tea-and-coffee cafe brand (originating in Rajasthan) reviving the traditional charm of kulhad beverages for modern customers. Also offers eco-friendly earthenware for sale, embracing sustainability, tradition, and health.
parent_company: Standalone brand founded by CA Samrat Shree Maheshwari
leader_name: CA Samrat Shree Maheshwari & Shweta Maheshwari

name: Cafe Creamoholic
short_description: Affordable 24/7 cafe-restaurant serving beverages and cafe food at pocket-friendly prices.
description: Cafe Creamoholic is a cafe and restaurant brand that started in 2016 in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, offering high-quality food and beverages at pocket-friendly prices compared with larger chains.

name: The Brew Tribe
short_description: Mobile coffee cart franchise serving freshly brewed coffee on-the-go.
description: The Brew Tribe started in Hyderabad in 2021 as an Indian "coffee-on-the-go" concept. The company uses eco-friendly electric rickshaw carts to serve freshly brewed coffee directly from mobile units.
leader_name: Sampath Samudrala, Sanjuwar Devalapally, Beena Sanjuwar, Seshaphani Samudrala

name: Just Dogs India
short_description: Premium pet retail and grooming franchise offering complete pet care solutions
description: Just Dogs India is India's largest pet retail and grooming chain specializing in pet grooming, retail, training services, and premium pet products. Established in 2011, the brand operates multiple formats ranging from boutique grooming spas to full-service concept stores. With presence across Tier-1 and Tier-2 cities, Just Dogs focuses on pet wellness, hygiene, safety, and customer satisfaction, making it a one-stop destination for pet care needs.

name: HomeLane India Private Limited
short_description: Technology-driven home interior design and modular furniture franchise.
description: HomeLane is India's leading home interior design platform launched in 2014. It offers end-to-end interior design and manufacturing services including modular kitchens, wardrobes, and customized home furnishings. The company manages the entire business lifecycle from lead generation to final installation using advanced 3D visualization tools and a strong franchise studio network across India.
parent_company: Homevista Decor and Furnishings Pvt. Ltd.

name: Medkart Pharmacy Private Limited
short_description: Affordable generic medicine pharmacy franchise focused on quality healthcare.
description: Medkart Pharmacy is India's trusted generic medicine pharmacy brand established in 2014. The company provides affordable healthcare solutions through a wide range of generic medicines, branded medicines, healthcare products, and wellness items. With 100+ stores across Gujarat and Rajasthan, Medkart combines physical retail pharmacies with an online presence to ensure accessibility and cost-effective healthcare for millions of customers.

name: BlueStone Jewelry Private Limited
short_description: Premium fine jewelry brand operating on a FOCO franchise model.
description: BlueStone is India's leading fine jewelry brand founded in 2011, specializing in certified diamonds, gemstones, and premium jewelry. The brand operates on a Franchise-Owned Company-Operated (FOCO) model where franchisees invest in store infrastructure while the company manages operations, inventory, staff, and marketing. BlueStone is publicly listed and continues rapid expansion across high-street locations and premium malls in major Indian cities.

name: Livspace India Private Limited
short_description: Technology-enabled home interior design and decor franchise offering end-to-end solutions.
description: Livspace is a technology-enabled home interior design and decor platform founded in 2015. It connects users with expert designers, contractors, and vendors providing 3D design visualization, curated home decor products, and project management support. Operating across India and internationally, Livspace leverages technology to streamline design collaboration with 1000+ pre-qualified vendors.
parent_company: Livspace Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) - India operating entity: Livspace India Private Limited

name: Duckback India Limited
short_description: Iconic rainwear and accessories franchise offering rain jackets, umbrellas, luggage, and footwear.
description: Duckback India is India's iconic rainwear brand established in 1920, known for quality, durability, and reliability. With presence across India through company-owned and franchise outlets, Duckback combines traditional quality with modern retail experiences in shopping malls and high-street locations, targeting Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities for franchise expansion.

name: BestFor India
short_description: Affordable and durable waterproof apparel and rainwear franchise targeting Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.
description: BestFor India is a leading Indian brand specializing in high-quality rainwear and waterproof apparel designed for Indian climate conditions. The brand operates through strategic retail partnerships across Indian cities and targets emerging entrepreneurs for franchise expansion in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities with low investment requirements.

name: Paragon Footwear
short_description: India's trusted footwear brand offering men, women, and children shoes
description: Paragon Footwear is India's trusted footwear brand founded in 1974, offering a wide range of shoes for men, women, and children with a strong distribution network and commitment to quality. The brand operates through strategic retail locations in high-street shopping zones and premium malls. Franchise partnership model commenced in 2015 with focus on organized footwear retail expansion. Premium positioning with emphasis on high-visibility retail locations in tier-1 cities.
leader_name: P.V. Abraham, K.U. Thomas & K.U. Scaria

name: Wurfel Kuche Pvt. Ltd.
short_description: Premium kitchen and interior solutions with modular kitchens and home furniture
description: Wurfel is a Germany-based premium kitchen and interior solutions brand, operating in India since 2015 with over 40 locations across major cities including Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kolkata. Specializing in modular kitchens, wardrobes, and home furniture with European design and functionality, Wurfel offers comprehensive interior design solutions tailored to Indian homes. Operates with royalty-free franchise model ensuring high profitability and strong support for franchisees.

name: Kirana King India
short_description: Modern retail grocery franchise with organized kirana store concept
description: Kirana King is a modern retail grocery franchise offering organized kirana stores with standardized operations, technology integration, and quality assurance. Established in 2014, franchise operations commenced in 2020 targeting Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities with ?50 lakhs to ?1 crore investment model for organized retail growth.

name: Polimeraas
short_description: Premium organic fruits and vegetables retailer
description: Polimeraas is India's premium organic fruits and vegetables retailer, established in 2018, offering seasonal, tropical, and exotic varieties sourced exclusively from organic farms across India. Franchise model offers 95% revenue to franchisee, 5% to franchisor, targeting rapid expansion across South India.

name: Ekirana Store
short_description: Fast e-commerce grocery and household delivery
description: Ekirana Store is an e-commerce company headquartered in Chandigarh, India, offering rapid home delivery of daily groceries and household products. Franchise model offers 200% ROI and 1-2 year payback, making it an attractive investment opportunity.

name: Solomon Software
short_description: IT services franchise - Web & ERP solutions
description: Solomon Software is a leading IT services company headquartered in Coimbatore, established in 2006, providing ERP solutions, web development, and digital services. Franchise model emphasizes entrepreneurship, low investment, fast ROI, home-based or small office operations.

name: Delberto Ecom Pvt. Ltd.
short_description: Zero-inventory e-commerce SaaS platform franchise
description: Delberto is an innovative e-commerce SaaS platform headquartered in Noida, founded in 2016, enabling entrepreneurs to launch zero-inventory online retail businesses without upfront product investment. Offers complete technology stack, marketing support, and logistics coordination.

name: Ezeesteps Online Retail Private Limited
short_description: E-commerce grocery delivery franchise
description: Ezeesteps Online Retail Private Limited is an e-commerce grocery delivery franchise operational in India offering local kirana convenience through modern delivery infrastructure. Registered in Jaipur with 100+ franchises.
leader_name: Chanchal Rai, Manish Sanatkumar Upadhyay, Rajesh Sanatkumar Upadhyay

name: Pay2Cart Private Limited
short_description: Hybrid e-commerce retail franchise
description: Pay2Cart Private Limited is a hybrid e-commerce retail company headquartered in Mumbai offering omnichannel shopping experience combining online and offline retail channels. Operating dual franchise models (FOCO/FOFO) since 2017.

name: Ajanta Shoes (India) Private Limited
short_description: Footwear retail franchise
description: Ajanta Shoes is a premium footwear brand established in 1956 in Kolkata with legacy of nearly 70 years offering quality shoes and sandals. Operating through established franchise network across Eastern India with 100+ franchises.
leader_name: Sagnik Banik, Jaydev Chatterjee, Vipul Kansal

name: INB Systech Pvt. Ltd.
short_description: Electronic appliance & IT education franchise
description: INB Systech Private Limited is an Electronic appliance Manufacturer Company focused on innovative and pocket-friendly product manufacturing. Recognised by Govt. of India under Start-up India Policy. Founded in 2016 by a Techno-Sales duo.
